pairs.why: B has the soft top spotlight and slightly smoother, less busy finish of the real drum kit; otherwise the two are nearly identical.
A matches the real card's warm overhead spotlight and calmer finish; B leans more on the ray background, which the real card doesn't have.
B's duck has a clean round head without the extra tuft and a handle near the neck, closer to how the real spring rider is built.
A has the plain round head and a handle near the neck like the real duck; B adds a head tuft and a handle on the saddle.
A puts the anchor on a navy badge on the white crown like the real cap, though the laurel wreath is extra detail.
B keeps the real cap's navy badge behind the anchor on the crown; A puts the anchor straight onto the band.
A's fronds spread wider and more jagged, and its trunk is more evenly segmented, closer to the real palm than B's rounded dome.
B has the wider-spread, spikier fronds and the evenly segmented trunk of the real palm; A's crown is more dome-shaped.
